title: Morphland does not disappoint in the release of his latest track, “Nowhere To Hide”
htmlContent:
Morphland is a talented rapper and songwriter from the Bronx. The poetic genius started his career with a seed planted ten years ago. Now a full-time producer, mixer, & multi-instrumentalist, I was learning the bearings of recording and sound engineering. MorphLand releases a fresh infectious sound titled “Nowhere To Hide.”

MorphLand’s “Nowhere to Hide” is a downtempo, heavily Dilla-inspired, intricate production. Everything about this record is commanding, with a complex sound in the presentation that sets the tone perfectly for his audiences to enjoy.
